name: Jehu (the prophet)
title: Prophet, son of Hanani
summary: Jehu, the son of the prophet Hanani, proclaimed God's word against both King Baasha of the Northern Kingdom and King Jehoshaphat of Judah. He also recorded the history of Jehoshaphat.

keyEvents.title: Prophesies Against Baasha
keyEvents.description: The word of the Lord came to Jehu son of Hanani against King Baasha because of his evil deeds.

keyEvents.title: Rebuking King Jehoshaphat
keyEvents.description: Jehu went out to meet Jehoshaphat and rebuked him for helping the wicked Ahab, yet he acknowledged the good that was in him.
